scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build --workspace @open-libra/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run dev --workspace @open-libra/web
scripts.check: npm run format && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:ui && npm run build:collaboration && node scripts/collaboration-durable-tests.mjs && node scripts/collaboration-tests.mjs && node scripts/shared-editor-tests.mjs && node scripts/automation-tests.mjs
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all --check && prettier --check apps/web/src scripts *.js *.json *.md docs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:rust && npm run lint:web
scripts.test:collaboration: npm run build:collaboration && npm run build && node scripts/collaboration-durable-tests.mjs && node scripts/collaboration-tests.mjs && node scripts/shared-editor-tests.mjs
scripts.test:shared-editor: npm run build:collaboration && npm run build && node scripts/shared-editor-tests.mjs
